I have farmed in Mzimba for many years and I know this 0.61 hectare plot well. Last season I used the government coupon fertilizer and hybrid seed on my maize, and the harvest was good enough to feed my family, so I will do the same this year. I will also spread manure because I keep cattle, but I will not buy chemicals or irrigate because the rain comes in November and maize does not need spraying. My family will do most of the work, but I will hire some young men for eight days when the work is heavy because at 67 my back is not what it used to be.
